prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game HUD component sprite atlas for Rainbow Patrol, a painted WWI biplane flying game. Reference image is the current working dashboard; match its aged brass, mahogany, worn leather and hand-painted detailed game-art finish. Create a NEW component atlas, not a complete dashboard screenshot. Canvas landscape 1536 by 1024 pixels. Exactly six separate sprites in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid, each cell 512 by 512, generous fully transparent gutters. No text, no numbers, no needles, no logos, no complete scene. Every sprite isolated on genuinely transparent background.
Top left cell: an elaborate round instrument FROST OVERLAY, crystals and fern-like hoarfrost growing from the outer edge of an approximately 410-pixel circular rim towards the center. Beautiful cool white and pale cyan ice, a little snow on upper rim, center 60 percent of circle completely transparent for readable live instrument markings. Transparent outside ring too.
Top middle cell: a horizontal aged-brass rectangular bezel 440 pixels wide by 180 pixels tall, with distinct white frost and tiny icicles along upper and lower edges. Entire central window transparent. Used over score/counter frames.
Top right cell: an irregular long horizontal frost-and-snow cluster 440 pixels wide by 160 pixels tall, delicate fern crystals and ice at a wooden cockpit edge, transparent gaps, no underlying wood or rectangle.
Bottom left cell: a complete round instrument BACKPLATE approximately 410 pixels diameter, dark almost black enamel, rich aged bronze rim, two small amber instrument lamps at upper edge casting visible warm pools of illumination into the blank black dial. No ticks, numbers or needle: dynamic markings will be drawn in code. Transparent outside the round backplate.
Bottom middle cell: a circular warm amber NIGHT LIGHT / GLASS OVERLAY approximately 410 pixels diameter, restrained bronze rim detail and small glowing amber lamps, elegant curved glass glint. Interior is mostly transparent, preserving live digits. This should clearly read as a lit antique aircraft instrument at night.
Bottom right cell: a horizontal blank black-enamel inset brass plaque 440 by 180 pixels with tiny warm amber lamps on the upper corners, warm lit border and dark readable center, no text. Transparent outside.
Keep all six sprites completely inside their grid cells with at least 35px transparent margin. Premium painted game sprite detail, clean alpha, no checkerboard painted into image. Frost should be substantial and visible, night lamps noticeably luminous, but protect readable center areas. Use the provided dashboard only as a material/style reference.
